title: ML -> RAG per-minute sensor document
description: sensor-features-v4 (2026-10-21). Three groups: measurements (c1 c2 c3 c5 c6 x mean/std, all 10, z + raw, sorted by |z|), states (c4 c10 c18 on-share), setpoints (c13..c16 mean/std raw + z). Produced by ml/.py/sensor_features.py every scored minute. ML sends measured facts only - no situation / symptom mapping, no model score.

value_space.description: every z: round(window_feature - model_feature_reference, 3) in the model's scaled, gun-centred space - not a universal standard-normal z-score

reference_id.description: model bundle of the normal reference (name@created)

gun_norm.description: warming_up = the gun's own normal is not fixed yet (first hours): z is against the global reference and less reliable

error_code.description: last non-zero controller code in this minute, as reported (e.g. E012); null = none

fault_class.description: set only when error_code is a terminal code (E012->E01, E016->E02, E028->E03, E029->E04; data mapping)

n_samples.description: 1 Hz rows the minute had (60 = complete)

measurements.description: All measured features, largest |z| first. value = raw mean / std (ddof 1) of the minute's CSV numbers; units are masked in the dataset.

states.description: 0/1 signals: c4 and c18 = 1 while the gun presses, c10 = US2 enable on. on_share = share of the minute they were on. All three 0 = the gun stood still: the measurement z are then frozen values, not deviations.

setpoints.description: What the controller was told. They change per weld spot (one program per spot), so std > 0 is normal and a setpoint z means 'another program mix than usual', never a fault by itself.
